# Reviewer catalog views (generated by views.py)

Rows: complaints raised by 2 or more reviewers of the same paper, specific praise raised by 2 or more reviewers. "reject reason" = share of complaint rows a reviewer or the meta-review treats as a main weakness or reason to reject. "rebuttal resolved" = share resolved among rows with a public rebuttal outcome (resolved, partly, not resolved). The 30 papers of the ICLR 2027 saturation run (19/11) have no severity or rebuttal tags and count only in frequencies. The CoRL venue sample (19 accepted CoRL 2023-2024 papers, all topics) is merged into the topic and venue views; CoRL publishes reviews of accepted papers only.
